name: Anas Ismail
researchKeywords: Palestinian health, health systems, medical referrals, health policy
bio: Anas Ismail is a Palestinian doctor and PhD student at Newcastle University. Before beginning his PhD, he worked with the Alliance for Health Policy and Systems Research at the World Health Organization.
researchFocus: Anas's doctoral research explores the health and social impact of outside medical referrals of Palestinian patients to Egypt and Jordan.

professionalRoles.title: Former team member
professionalRoles.organisation: Alliance for Health Policy and Systems Research, World Health Organization
